info.title: Sift — Phase 1-4 Baseline RAG
info.description: Data ingestion + quality profiling + content store + web crawler + cleaning workflow + baseline RAG

post.summary: Ingest a website via sitemap or single URL
post.description:
Crawl a website and store extracted text as documents.

- Validates URL and performs SSRF protection.
- Respects robots.txt (user-agent: SiftBot).
- Discovers pages via sitemap.xml (with one level of sitemap index support).
- Applies 1.5s inter-host delay, 10s timeout, 5MB response limit, max 3 redirects.
- Extracts main content using trafilatura (no JavaScript execution).
- Runs heuristic text quality checks on each document.
- Returns a summary of stored and skipped pages.

get.summary: List all sources with document and record counts
get.description: Return all sources, each with a count of associated documents and records.

get.summary: List documents for a source (no content body)
get.description:
Return document metadata for a source.
The full content field is omitted — use GET /documents/{id} for that.

get.summary: Aggregate quality report for a source
get.description:
Compute and return an aggregate quality report for all documents in a source.

Includes:
  - document_count, total_words
  - duplicate_groups (exact), near_duplicate_pairs
  - freshness_distribution
  - short_documents list
  - injection_suspects list
  - issues: human-readable list with severity (critical / warning / info)

All quality signals are heuristics — labeled as such in the output.

get.summary: Get a full document including content
get.description:
Return a single document by ID, including its full text content.
For a list without content, use GET /sources/{source_id}/documents.

put.summary: Set or update metadata overrides for a document
put.description:
Set user metadata overrides (published_at, title) for a document.
- Original document row remains strictly untouched (immutability preserved).
- Rejects unparsable dates and dates more than 1 day in the future.
- Overrides take effect only for a NEW index run.

get.summary: Get metadata overrides for a document
get.description: Retrieve the current metadata overrides for a document.

delete.summary: Delete metadata overrides for a document
delete.description: Delete metadata overrides for a document. Original document remains unchanged.

post.summary: Infer column roles for a structured source
post.description:
Run rule-based role inference on the latest version of a source's records.
Does NOT overwrite roles that are already confirmed by the user.
Returns the full role list after inference.

get.summary: Get column roles for a source
get.description: Return all column roles for the source.

put.description:
Set one or more column roles, marking them confirmed=TRUE.
These will not be overwritten by future infer calls.

post.summary: Generate (or regenerate) cleaning proposals for a source
post.description:
Analyse the latest version of a source and generate cleaning proposals.

- Replaces any existing PENDING proposals (does not touch approved/rejected/applied).
- Returns the new proposal list.

get.summary: List proposals for a source
get.description: Return proposals for a source, optionally filtered by status.

post.summary: Bulk-approve proposals at or above a minimum severity
post.description:
Convenience endpoint: approves all PENDING proposals whose severity is
>= min_severity (critical > warning > info).

This still requires an explicit POST /sources/{id}/apply to take effect.

parameters.name: min_severity

schema.description: Approve proposals at this severity or more critical: critical|warning|info
schema.title: Min Severity

parameters.description: Approve proposals at this severity or more critical: critical|warning|info

post.summary: Apply approved proposals and create a new version
post.description:
Apply all approved proposals, create version N+1, and return a summary.

Nothing is applied automatically — this endpoint must be called explicitly.

get.summary: List all versions for a source
get.description: Return all source_versions rows for this source, newest first.

get.summary: Get the stored quality profile for a specific version
get.description: Return the stored profiler output for a given (source, version).

get.summary: Compare quality metrics between two versions
get.description:
Return a diff of row counts and profile metrics between two versions.

Output:
  - row_counts: {active, excluded, quarantined} for each version
  - status_delta: change in each status bucket
  - profile_delta: per-metric difference (from profile JSONs if available)

get.summary: Get paginated rows for a specific version and status
get.description:
Return paginated record/document rows for a given version and optional status.
Includes quarantine/exclude reason from row metadata.

post.summary: Index active content for a source version
post.description:
Index active documents and structured records for a source into pgvector.
- Only content with status='active' is chunked and embedded.
- Re-indexing creates a new index run (older runs are preserved for comparison).
- Fails fast if the embedding model dimension does not match the database column.

get.summary: List all index runs for a source
get.description: Return all index runs for a source ordered by most recent first.

get.summary: Preview chunks for an index run
get.description:
Return content preview and metadata for chunks of an index run.
Embedding vectors are intentionally excluded from responses.

post.summary: Analyze query and return deterministic routing decision
post.description:
Pure rule-based query analyzer and router.
Evaluates schema context, extracts features, and decides execution route (structured, exact, complex, semantic).
CRITICAL: Does NOT call LLM, does NOT call embedding model, and does NOT execute query.

post.summary: Execute RAG search and grounded generation or structured computation
post.description:
Search indexed content and generate a grounded, cited answer or compute deterministic aggregation.
- Selectable strategies: 'dense' (baseline), 'lexical', 'hybrid', 'hybrid_rerank', and 'auto'.
- With 'auto': analyzes query with rule-based router. Structured route computes deterministic template
  without LLM or embeddings. Other routes execute RAG pipeline with chosen strategy.
- If evidence gate fails: returns status 'insufficient_evidence' (LLM is NOT called).
- If answers lack valid citations: returns status 'unverified'.
- If citations are valid: returns status 'answered'.

Evaluate multiple retrieval strategies side-by-side on the same query and filters.
CRITICAL: Does NOT call the LLM.
Returns per-strategy ranked chunks with explainability signals, evidence gate outcomes,
stage latencies, and an overlap summary comparing rank changes against dense baseline.

get.summary: Get assembled trace explanation for a query
get.description:
Returns an assembled explanation for a past query:
- Route decision and rules evaluated
- Strategy and filters
- Per-stage latency
- For computed answers: template, SQL-level description (bound placeholders, no raw values), rows_used, and data_quality_notes
- For retrieval answers: candidates with explainability signals, evidence gate outcome, valid/dropped citations

get.summary: Get query details and retrieval results
get.description: Retrieve details of a past query including retrieved chunks, scores, signals, route, and citation status.

get.summary: List recent queries

post.summary: Extract read-only data profile from sources
post.description:
Build KB profile from existing DB data only.
No network calls, no model execution.

Compute KB profile and evaluate deterministic rules R1-R12.
Stores recommendation in status 'proposed'.

get.summary: List recommendations
Get recommendation by ID

post.description:
Apply an approved recommendation.
Creates or reuses baseline config (Phase 4 baseline) and recommended config.
Builds/reuses index runs matching chunking specs if build_index is True.
Idempotent: repeated apply does not duplicate configs or index runs.
Accepts build_index in JSON body or as a query parameter.

get.summary: List pipeline configs
Compare two pipeline configs field-by-field
Get pipeline graph in JSON or Mermaid
Get pipeline config by ID

post.summary: Upload a file and receive a quality report
post.description:
Accept a CSV, XLSX, PDF, DOCX, or image file.
1. Validate extension and size.
2. Parse the file.
3. Profile the parsed data.
4. Save metadata + report to PostgreSQL.
5. Persist content to sources/documents/records (Phase 2 backfill).
6. Return the report as JSON (now includes source_id).

get.summary: Get quality report by file ID
get.description: Return the saved quality report for the given file_id.

get.summary: List all uploaded files with a short summary
get.description: Return all uploaded files, each with a one-line summary of the quality report.

published_after.title: Published After
published_after.description: Only chunks published on or after this timestamp.

published_before.title: Published Before
published_before.description: Only chunks published on or before this timestamp.

title_contains.title: Title Contains
title_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring search in document title.

RetrievalFilters.title: RetrievalFilters
RetrievalFilters.description:
Whitelisted metadata filters for chunk retrieval.
Any unknown keys are rejected with validation error (HTTP 422).
